turns.question: How many credit hours is a full teaching load, and how many office hours must faculty hold?
turns.answer:
o "A" Regular Faculty (Assistant, Associate, Full Professor) is devoted to developing and delivering undergraduate and graduate courses, conducting research, and performing service. The baseline teaching load for this category is 12 credit hours per semester.

o Ranked full time regular faculty, visiting faculty or senior lecturer workload equal to 12 credit hours per regular semester or 24 credit hours per academic year.

Full-Time Faculty: Full-time faculty members in academic and career/technical programs are required to schedule a minimum of five office hours per week, spread over a minimum of two days. These office hours provide dedicated time for students to discuss course- related matters, seek clarifications, and receive academic support.
turns.evidence_note: Handbook p96 and p91 state 12 credit hours per semester; p79 states a minimum of five office hours per week over two days.

turns.question: How do I export the attendance sheet for my Blackboard Collaborate sessions?
turns.answer:
D- Checking Session Attendance

From the Details & Actions panel, Click on attendance tool.

On the attendance panel, select overview at the top right.

You will have an overview for all sessions conducted, the students will be marked automatically, and the instructor will be able to change the marks as absent, excused, late and present.

If you want to export the attendance sheet, click on export icon, and an excel sheet will be downloaded to your device.
turns.evidence_note: Collaborate Guide p4 'D- Checking Session Attendance': the procedure ends with the export step the question asks.
